expectation: MPO is cytoplasmic and granular, in neutrophils (also monocytes and basophils). It should appear as sparse, discrete, bright cell-sized spots, in clusters or scattered in the stroma and vessels, and mostly outside dense lymphocyte areas.
observed: A: sparse yellow cell-sized puncta in most tiles, with dense clusters in a few (top, tile 3). Background is dark and does not follow the nuclear density. B/C: discrete 8-15 um bright cells, some in small groups, on a clean background. D: compact granular cell bodies beside nuclei.
why: The signal is a sparse set of discrete, cell-sized, bright cells that cluster in some tiles, on a clean background, as expected for neutrophil MPO.
